title: Isomorphism descent through a scalar adjunction square
statement: Let CY:A→B and CX:C→D have right adjoints RY and RX; let Fm:A→C and Fn:B→D have right adjoints Gm and Gn. Suppose Fn reflects isomorphisms, γ:CY Fn≅Fm CX and δ:RX Gm≅Gn RY are isomorphisms satisfying the displayed iterated-transpose mate identity. Given Nm≅Gm(Mm), Nn≅Gn(Mn), transitions τN:Nm→RY(Nn), τM:Mm→RX(Mn) satisfying the δ comparison square, assume the counits at Mm and Mn and the CX-adjoint transpose of τM are invertible. Then the CY-adjoint transpose of τN is invertible. No boundedness or faithfulness on the scalar-extension objects is assumed.

source.place: Formal adjunction-mate argument for the normalization consequence of Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10, original comparison proof step 11.

proof.text: Let z be the CY-adjoint transpose of τN, and transpose z followed by the evaluation identification under Fn⊣Gn to obtain f. Apply the mate identity and the transition square. Naturality under Fm⊣Gm identifies γ⁻¹f with CX applied to Fm(em) followed by the counit, and then the scalar transpose of τM. All factors are invertible, so f is invertible.
The Fn-adjunction counit formula gives f=Fn(z) Fn(en) εn. Cancel the invertible last factors and use reflection by Fn to conclude that z is invertible.

theorem isIso_scalar_transpose_of_mate
    {A : Type a} [Category.{av} A] {B : Type b} [Category.{bv} B]
    {C : Type c} [Category.{cv} C] {D : Type d} [Category.{dv} D]
    {CY : A ⥤ B} {RY : B ⥤ A} (ay : CY ⊣ RY)
    {CX : C ⥤ D} {RX : D ⥤ C} (ax : CX ⊣ RX)
    {Fm : A ⥤ C} {Gm : C ⥤ A} (am : Fm ⊣ Gm)
    {Fn : B ⥤ D} {Gn : D ⥤ B} (an : Fn ⊣ Gn)
    [Fn.ReflectsIsomorphisms]
    (γ : CY ⋙ Fn ≅ Fm ⋙ CX) (δ : RX ⋙ Gm ≅ Gn ⋙ RY)
    (hδ : ∀ (P : A) (Q : D) (f : Fn.obj (CY.obj P) ⟶ Q),
      ay.homEquiv P (Gn.obj Q) (an.homEquiv _ Q f) =
        am.homEquiv P (RX.obj Q)
          (ax.homEquiv (Fm.obj P) Q (γ.inv.app P ≫ f)) ≫ δ.hom.app Q)
    {Nm : A} {Nn : B} {Mm : C} {Mn : D}
    (em : Nm ≅ Gm.obj Mm) (en : Nn ≅ Gn.obj Mn)
    (τN : Nm ⟶ RY.obj Nn) (τM : Mm ⟶ RX.obj Mn)
    (hτ : τN ≫ RY.map en.hom = em.hom ≫ Gm.map τM ≫ δ.hom.app Mn)
    [IsIso (am.counit.app Mm)] [IsIso (an.counit.app Mn)]
    [IsIso ((ax.homEquiv Mm Mn).symm τM)] :
    IsIso ((ay.homEquiv Nm Nn).symm τN)
